scope: Standalone kernel-only compile on the build server with the Android tree's prebuilt toolchain and Lineage kernel.mk make flags. Not a ROM build, boot test or root-function test.

results.kbuild_source_edits: none; path_umount/can_umount pre-applied so the in-build sed backports did not run

interpretation: Identical exported CRCs mean the KSU kernel is expected to accept the normal build's vendor modules (MODVERSIONS ignores the release string in vermagic). This is unverified until the device test in KSU-02.
upstream_behavior_kept: Native KernelSU Next legacy features are compiled and wired as upstream ships them, including default-on selinux_hide and adb_root. The slow_avc_audit hook is wired because upstream's kprobes mode registers it automatically; the avc_spoof feature stays under KernelSU Next's own runtime switch.
not_performed: boot, SELinux enforcing check, module load, Manager grant/deny

hooks.fs/exec.c __do_execve_file: ksu_handle_execveat (covers execve, execveat and compat paths)
hooks.fs/namespace.c, fs/internal.h: can_umount/path_umount backport (same code as upstream Kbuild would insert)
